How Ticks work

Ticks are the Vault's currency. They cannot be bought with money at any price — every one is earned, which is what makes a Tick-priced frame worth wearing.

Where they go

Two sinks, both yours to choose.
The VaultFrames, ticket skins and card backgrounds. Common 300 T, rare 1,200 T, epic 3,000 T, legendary 7,000 T.
Duel stakesWager Ticks head to head. Winner takes the pot; a tie returns both stakes. Duels used to stake XP, which meant losing one could cost you a level — Ticks cannot.

XP and Ticks are different things on purpose. XP only ever goes up and decides your level; Ticks are what you spend. Nothing you buy here can ever cost you a rank.

Ticks are the Vault's earned currency: spending them can never cost you a level, because XP is now purely your progress and is never deducted. Balance purchases come out of your withdrawable rewards balance and are final. Equipped items show on your public trader card, in chat and on the leaderboards.
